title: James Clerk Maxwell: A Treatise on Electricity and Magnetism, Volume I Source-Witnessed LaTeX Working Tranches
description:
Dedicated James Clerk Maxwell working-edition record for A Treatise on Electricity and Magnetism, Volume I. This version replaces the compact first-edition reverification tranche with printed pp.001-055 / Internet Archive 1873 first-edition leaves, while retaining the earlier ledger-backed source-witnessed working tranches for book pages 95-101, 103, 105, 109, and the main continuous run 111-267. The pp.001-055 tranche is a source-page-boundary update: printed p.055 ends with the page-boundary fragment “It is probable that the value for”; continuation begins on p.056.

Status at a glance. This is not a complete Treatise edition and not a final critical edition. It should be cited as source-witnessed working tranches. The pp.001-055 package contains editable TeX, reader PDF, LaTeX log/compile captures, a compact source-scan witness PDF, a relative source-image list, render check, page registers, checksums, and a status note. A pp.001-056 rolling build exists locally but is not promoted here because it ends mid-page/mid-sentence.

Source-check ledgers and source witness images govern promoted range claims. OCR/XML material is used as a locator/witness layer, not as textual authority. The pp.001-055 reader build completes with one small inherited overfull hbox of about 1.15305 pt; this is a layout-polish caveat rather than a missing-source claim.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
version: 2026-06-12 IA1873 pp.001-055 plus source-witnessed working tranches through book page 267
notes: Curated package created from the local Maxwell old-physics lane. Publish and read as source-witnessed working tranches, not as a complete Maxwell Treatise or critical edition. Current verified ranges from the ledgers: pp.001-055 from the IA 1873 first-edition reverification lane, plus book pages 95-101, 103, 105, 109, and 111-267 from the earlier working-tranche lane. The older pp.001-046 compact tranche is superseded by pp.001-055. Printed p.056 is the next continuation point; the local pp.001-056 rolling build is not promoted in this version.
